title: Fukuyama sister city delegation and follow-up
summary: On October 20, a committee deferred its discussion of the sister city relationship with Fukuyama City, Japan, setting it aside for later. A 2008 resolution made Fukuyama City a sister city of Maui County. A Fukuyama delegation visited the Council on September 30, a few months after an earlier June welcome.

timeline.text: Sister city relationship discussion: The committee deferred the sister city discussion.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The delegation gave the Council a denim tablecloth as a gift.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: The chair said the delegation would leave for an evening presentation at UH Maui College after a group photo.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: A speaker said the federal government gave 1.6 billion dollars for housing and rebuilding.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: A guest asked who is in charge of water and power as Lahaina recovers.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: The chair said a resolution adopted on February 11, 2008, made Fukuyama City a sister city of Maui County.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: The Maui County Council held a special meeting to welcome members of the Fukuyama City Assembly.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: The mayor's office said that after Council approval of the sister city resolution, it would notify the city and plan a ceremonial acceptance.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The vice chair agreed to discuss the sister city topic further in the vice chair's committee.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: All available council members were invited, and light refreshments will be provided.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The meet-and-greet is set for 4 to 5 p.m.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: Staff asked the chair to announce that a delegation from the Fukuyama City Council will visit for a meet-and-greet in the council chamber.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The chair thanked the visitors for coming to commemorate the sister city relationship.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: A councilmember from Molokaʻi danced a hula to a mele about Molokaʻi.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The visitors gave gifts, including a rose-flavored ramen.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The chair asked the visitors to come up to receive lei.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The president of Fukuyama City University said he hopes for more active ties between younger generations.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: A Fukuyama delegation leader said he hopes to deepen the relationship between Fukuyama and Maui.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: An assistant clerk danced a hula to Puamana, a mele about a family home in Lahaina.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: A Council Services Hawaiian language specialist sang the mele (song) Kila Kila o Maui.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The managing director thanked the Fukuyama visitors on behalf of the mayor.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The chair said the rose is the official flower of both Fukuyama City and Maui Island.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: A sister chamber relationship between Fukuyama and Maui Japanese chambers of commerce existed as of May 31, 1997.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The chair said a Council resolution established the Maui County–Fukuyama City sister city relationship.
timeline.body: Maui County Council: 2026 Fukuyama Sister City Chamber of Commerce & Industry Visit

timeline.text: The Maui County Council welcomed a delegation from Fukuyama City, Japan, in the Council Chamber.
